positions.as_written: **Q.** Does this mean my daughter should not play?
Release criteria matter more in this group precisely because the re-injury rate is higher, so a time based release is harder to defend here than anywhere else in the chapter.
Take all five explicitly rather than by impression, and ask who decides when she plays.
